title: Others coming and going can price a staker out of withdrawing: the same test with its assertion turned around

source.adaptedHow: A test of our own, written from the finding's description, that asserts the safe property, so it fails while the bug is present. The finding's test needs a raised --gas-limit, which a listing's commands cannot set, and only logs the gas; this one pauses gas metering for its set-up and asserts the limit.
